desert wind-farm engineer, far-future, rendered as cel-shaded concept art moodboard, a low-key grade holding detail in the deepest shadows only, raw plaster

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a neutral commercial grade with clean whites and no colour cast. Lighting reference: north-facing window light with a black v-flat for negative fill.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.
